cd /tmp/obench-cell-gei1g99j/bench_opencode_sam-cell-seg_okd_1b1i && python3 - <<'EOF'
s=open('convert_masks.py').read()
s=s.replace("    return out.astype(bool) & (mask | ~mask)  # filled\n","    return out.astype(bool)\n")
old=s[s.index('    p = argparse.ArgumentParser'):s.index('    return p.parse_args()')]
new='''    p = argparse.ArgumentParser(description="Convert cell masks to polylines using MobileSAM.")
    names = ["weights_path", "output_path", "rgb_path", "csv_path"]
    helps = ["Path to MobileSAM weights (mobile_sam.pt)",
             "Output folder (or .csv file path) for the refined masks",
             "Path to the RGB image", "Path to the metadata csv"]
    # Accept both positional and --flag style arguments.
    for n, h in zip(names, helps):
        p.add_argument(n + "_pos", nargs="?", default=None, metavar=n, help=h)
    for n, h in zip(names, helps):
        p.add_argument("--" + n, type=str, default=None, help=h)
    a = p.parse_args()
    for n in names:
        if getattr(a, n) is None:
            setattr(a, n, getattr(a, n + "_pos"))
        if getattr(a, n) is None:
            p.error(f"missing required argument: {n}")
    return a
'''
s=s.replace(old+'    return p.parse_args()\n',new)
open('convert_masks.py','w').write(s)
EOF
W=/opt/uvcache/git-<REDACTED_B64>mobile_sam.pt
time .venv/bin/python convert_masks.py --weights_path $W --output_path out --rgb_path demo_rgb.png --csv_path demo_metadata.csv 2>&1 | grep -v Warn | tail -3
